subject: Renewal: onboarding refresh, PO thresholds & insurance upload
messages:
From: Claire Dunne <claire@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-02 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal request + capacity bump / onboarding refresh

Hi Marissa,

We’re preparing the renewal packet for Helio Health and want to increase committed capacity by 40% starting with the next term (12 months) — usage has spiked and the clinical team needs more steady throughput. Procurement has asked for: a refreshed vendor onboarding bundle, current insurance certificate, and the updated PO to include the amended seat/capacity numbers.

Can Redwood:
- Provide a short vendor onboarding evidence bundle we can upload to our procurement portal?
- Confirm whether you can accept a PO amendment effective mid-billing-cycle (we may issue a PO on Oct 15th).
- Share a draft amendment or a DocuSign link for signature and the updated pricing for the +40% uplift.

I’ve attached our current PO for reference. Timelines: procurement wants everything uploaded by Oct 12th to make the Nov renewal cut. Let me know who on your team I should work with directly on the evidence upload.

Thanks,
Claire Dunne
Sr. Procurement Manager
Helio Health
Attachment: current_PO_2027.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunne <claire@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-02 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal request + capacity bump / onboarding refresh

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the PO. Looping in Rishi (AE) to lead the commercial bits, Laura (legal) for the amendment, and Ben (finance) for the PO/terms.

High-level plan from Redwood:
1) We’ll produce a condensed vendor onboarding bundle (SOC2 summary, data handling brief, insurance cert stub, and evidence checklist) for Helio’s portal upload.
2) Legal can prepare a short amendment for the +40% capacity increase and revised price. We can accept PO amendments mid-cycle but need the PO to reference the amendment and effective date.
3) We’ll push a DocuSign link and a draft amendment by EOD 10/03. Procurement portal upload instructions would be helpful — I can coordinate the files directly once we have access.

Tentative owners and timing:
- Rishi: pricing & MAP delivery (target 10/03)
- Laura: amendment draft (target 10/03 EOD)
- Ben: confirm invoicing lane + PO acceptance (target 10/04)
- Marissa: evidence bundle & portal upload (target 10/04)

Attached a simple evidence checklist so we can accelerate the upload (vendor-evidence-checklist.xlsx). If you can grant our portal upload access (or share SFTP/Drive), we’ll start adding files immediately.

Best,
Marissa
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor-evidence-checklist.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunne <claire@heliohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-03 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal request + capacity bump / onboarding refresh

Claire — I’ll take point on the mutual action plan and revised commercial terms. Attached is a quick MAP and a redline of the uplift pricing (MAP-v2.pdf). Summary:
- Deal ID: DW-98721
- Current committed throughput: 1.2T tokens / mo → proposed 1.68T tokens / mo (40% uplift)
- Price impact: blended CPM + seat uplift reflected in the attached MAP; we can offer a 6% credit on committed spend if you lock a 12-month term.

On PO logistics: we can accept an amendment effective on the date you nominate, mid-cycle is acceptable as long as the PO references the amendment ID and the effective date. Ben — can you confirm whether invoicing prefers amendment-date proration or pro-rata adjustment on the next invoice?

Claire, happy to hop on a 20-min call to run the MAP through your procurement team if that helps — is 10/04 11am PT good?

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP-v2.pdf
From: Claire Dunne <claire@heliohealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2028-10-03 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal request + capacity bump / onboarding refresh

Thanks Rishi — the 11am PT slot on 10/04 works for a short sync.

We’ll upload the procurement questionnaire (10 pages) and the updated PO once we finalize the amendment language. Procurement noted two items of particular importance:
- Insurance certificate matching our MSA minimums (they asked for a PDF certificate with policy number).
- PO thresholds: can Redwood accept a lower threshold for electronic PO acceptance? Our centralized PO system sometimes issues mid-month POs; procurement asked if Redwood will accept Net 30 and allow amendment-effective dates that land mid-cycle.

We’re attaching the questionnaire now so Laura can review for any legal compliance asks on your side. We’ll also share a portal link for file uploads (we’ll grant Redwood team contributor access).

Claire
Attachment: Helio_questionnaire_v1.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunne <claire@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-05 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal request + capacity bump / onboarding refresh

Claire — thanks for the questionnaire — we reviewed it and attached a draft amendment and a short note on insurance requirements. Key points:
- We can accept PO amendments mid-cycle. Redwood prefers the PO reference to a signed amendment ID and the effective date for accounting. We will pro-rate any billing change to the effective date unless you request otherwise.
- Insurance: we will provide a certificate of insurance; I’ve summarized the minimal fields your procurement referenced in insurance_req_summary.pdf. If your team needs the carrier to name Redwood Inference as an additional insured, flag that now so we can confirm with our broker.
- Compliance evidence: we’ll provide a SOC2 summary and a short data handling brief in the vendor bundle. The SOC2 full report is gated — we can arrange an NDAed pull if procurement requires it.

I’m attaching the amendment draft (redwood-terms-amendment_draft.docx) and the insurance summary. Next steps:
1) Marissa to upload the evidence bundle to your portal once access is shared.
2) We’ll send the DocuSign for the amendment (Rishi to confirm pricing in the DocuSign).
3) Ben will confirm invoicing lane and PO acceptance cadence.

If helpful, we can do a short legal-to-legal 15-min call during the Rishi sync on 10/04 to walk through the questionnaire items.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-terms-amendment_draft.docx; insurance_req_summary.pdf
